author: isectech_
text: New CISA KEV (Oct 29): Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 (8.6, SSL VPN DoS, actively exploited) + GitLab CVE-2026-97229 (10.0, unauth RCE). Patch both federal due Sun Nov 1.

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) in GitLab CE/EE is actively exploited by attackers. Exploitation allows unauthenticated remote attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution via specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration.

author: ThreatWire_
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED: Drupal Commerce Core authorization flaw (CVE-2026-118539, Highly critical 21/25). Attackers placed fraudulent orders on live shops, some at $0.01. No login needed. Fixed: 3.3.13 / 8.x-2.41.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell) are actively exploited against PAN-OS firewalls. A China-nexus actor chained them with a kernel privesc to root 25 firewalls including U.S. government systems.

author: CCBalert
text: Warning: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability, CVE-2026-46300 (CVSS 7.8), is actively exploited in the wild. Could allow a local attacker to achieve root privileges or container escape.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: active exploitation confirmed. ACTIVELY EXPLOITED - Ivanti Connect Secure - CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527.

author: JadenJohnsNews
text: WordPress RCE Vulnerability Actively Exploited After Patch Release. WordPress 7.1.4 fixed 22 security flaws, including an unauthenticated RCE caused by a race condition in the core update process. Within hours, attackers began targeting sites.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code.

author: cordobahq
text: CVE-2026-76418 (CVSS 8.6): actively exploited flaw in Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and FTD Remote Access SSL VPN lets an unauthenticated attacker reload the device. Patches released.

author: stretchcloud
text: CVE-2026-85046, a type confusion bug in V8 that Google patched in Chrome 152.0.7977.82 after confirming it was already being exploited. AI agent browsers running cached Chromium remain exposed.

author: TheHackerWire
text: CVE-2026-62863 (CVSS 9.6 Critical): Unauthenticated /sse & /message endpoints with wildcard CORS in MoLing MCP Server (< 0.5.0) let malicious web pages trigger localhost RCE.

author: Iam_Shivanshu
text: GHSA-4prq-p2x5-w9fh / CVE-2026-115413 in awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server: MCP server checked token signature, issuer and expiry but never the audience. High, CVSS 7.3.

author: noelkimx
text: Agno's PandasTools passed a model-chosen function name to getattr, so a prompt injection could make the agent call read_pickle on an attacker's file and run code (CVE-2026-119050).

author: marcoscyberx
text: Langflow's MCP command field was passed straight to a shell. Any logged-in user could run commands (CVSS 9.9). Honeypots logged 1,706 exploit attempts from 28 IPs, hunting for secret keys and superuser passwords.

author: fireball_triada
text: A malicious MCP server can run PowerShell on your PC during OAuth sign-in. OpenCode 1.0.137-1.18.32 on Windows/WSL passed the server's auth URL to open@10.x. Root cause: CVE-2026-119025. Fixed silently.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Two missing checks in Datalayer's jupyter-mcp-server let any website hijack an AI assistant's live notebook connection, per Pluto Security research disclosure.

author: stretchcloud
text: Stuffing JavaScript comments with nuclear and biological weapons terminology makes AI code scanners refuse to look at the file; now a documented malware evasion technique.

author: ycnewsdigest
text: The official Claude Code VS Code extension on Cursor's marketplace shipped a hidden SSH backdoor (v2.1.312/313). It plants a key, tries to enable Remote Login, and opens a reverse tunnel to 134.209.82.225.

author: lordnewss
text: A supply chain attack compromised 5,000 developer machines via malicious Anthropic Claude extensions. A coding flaw in the malware prevented full system infiltration.

author: markgadala
text: BREAKING: Major Security Breach Hits Northflank, a cloud platform trusted by 2,000+ startups and enterprises, used to deploy production applications, databases, and AI workloads.

author: Kuberns_cloud
text: On Northflank? Assume every secret you stored there is already leaked. Rotate. Revoke. Check your billing. Second platform breach in 9 days.

author: ignisjuliuxo
text: Some of our API keys stored in Railway were leaked in their security breach; migrating off Railway.

author: Coin_Scoop
text: Chainalysis links the Binance hack to North Korean-affiliated group TraderTraitor.

author: Codezero_io
text: One API key committed to GitHub in May, never revoked, cost LiteLLM its release pipeline: leaked master key pulled a GitHub token that harvested Anthropic, OpenAI and AWS keys, and the attacker shipped poisoned code.

author: Python_s_
text: Aokigahara Windows infostealer targets AI sessions and developer credentials, analyzed by Check Point Research.

author: dailytechonx
text: A North Korea-aligned group now steals Git credentials and injects malware via npm, PyPI packages and GitHub, using blockchain tricks to avoid takedowns. Rotate keys and audit dependencies.

author: vuln_u
text: The internet has declared a PHP server apocalypse. Matt looked at the actual risk, the 32 million vulnerable servers being cited, and the AI-generated exploit videos spreading alongside the story.

author: forbot26
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-118527 in Ivanti Connect Secure (predictable number generation). On CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list since 2026-10-30. Patch now.

author: SaferCrypto
text:

AI-discovered PHP flaws triggered millions of exploit attempts, forcing sites offline in France and Finland. NSA urged immediate patching. Use MFA, hardware keys and unique passwords.

text:

author: scarnago
text: CrowdStrike's researchers have expanded the Prompt Injection Taxonomy to 222 techniques, revealing new ways adversaries manipulate how AI agents plan, reason, and act.

author: blackorbird
text:
Evolution of AI-Powered Attacks
Stages 1–2: Adversaries moved from prompt-based LLM use for malware code, phishing, personas, and reconnaissance to embedding LLMs in malware like HONESTCUE and PROMPTSPY to dynamically obfuscate payloads and evade defenses.

Stage 3: Agentic LLMs

author: AgentWorkshq
text: Spring AI 2.0.1 fixed 7 CVEs. On 2.0.0? Upgrade. Two matter for agents: an unadvertised tool could be dispatched via prompt injection; Redis chat memory could expose data across conversations.

author: Riftweldsec
text: Drupal Commerce Core access bypass CVE-2026-118539 is being actively exploited against online stores. Patch to 3.3.13 or 8.x-2.41 now, then audit orders.
